channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Logical Take | When Infrastructure Talks to People: What Japan Teaches India About Designing Cities for the Blind
item.description: Japan’s standardised, enforced accessibility system enables independence for the visually impaired, while India’s fragmented implementation leaves millions dependent despite progressive laws.

item.title: India–US Trade Deal Row Deepens; Govt Dismisses Rahul Gandhi’s ‘Anti-Farmer’ Allegations
item.description: A sharp political showdown has erupted after Rahul Gandhi alleged the interim India–US trade deal harms farmers, while the government insists agricultural interests remain fully protected.

item.title: Meet Roohi Mohazzab: India’s Young Environmentalist Honoured with 2026 UN SDG Award in Bangkok
item.description: Roohi Mohazzab, a six-year-old student from Kerala addressed global leaders at the United Nations in Bangkok, urging climate responsibility.

item.title: From Fare Meters to Fraud Prevention: SEBI and NSDL Launch 1,000 Auto-Rickshaws to Promote Investor Safety
item.description: SEBI and NSDL have deployed a fleet of branded auto-rickshaws equipped with QR codes to encourage citizens to verify payment details and intermediary registrations before investing.

item.title: Viral Soft Drink ‘Refill’ Video at Arun Jaitley Stadium Sparks Hygiene Concerns; DDCA Says It Was Waste Disposal Protocol
item.description: A viral clip from a T20 World Cup match in Delhi prompted hygiene concerns before the DDCA clarified it was part of an authorised waste disposal process.

item.title: “Shuru Kisne Kiya” – McVitie’s Campaign That Playfully Tickles A Long-Standing Question
item.description: An exploration of India’s shared everyday rituals and how McVitie’s cleverly connects them to its 186-year baking legacy.

item.title: 10-Month-Old Aalin Becomes Kerala’s Youngest Organ Donor, Saving 5 Lives Through Parents’ Courage
item.description: After being declared brain-dead following a road accident, 10-month-old Aalin Sherin Abraham’s donated organs saved five lives, marking her as Kerala’s youngest organ donor.

item.title: Over 9,438 Lives Lost in India to Pothole Accidents Between 2020 and 2024; Uttar Pradesh Reports 5,127 Deaths
item.description: Government data reveals a sharp rise in pothole-related road deaths across India, raising urgent questions about infrastructure maintenance, accountability, and public safety.

item.title: Centre Cracks Down on Forced Service Charges: 27 Restaurants Penalised, ₹50,000 Fine Enforced After Court-Backed Ban
item.description: The government has reinforced that service charges in restaurants must remain voluntary, imposing penalties and refund orders on establishments that continue to levy them by default despite clear legal guidelines.

item.title: After 145 Years, Darjeeling Toy Train Gets Its First Woman TTE
item.description: Sarita Yolmo’s appointment marks a historic gender breakthrough on the UNESCO-listed Darjeeling Himalayan Railway.
